claim: Patchline ships an open research-problems registry with bounties and gate-checkable success criteria. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the bounties claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make research-problems-registry-gate`.
